conclusion: Both arms failed closed on a harness infrastructure gap, not a model result: the fresh container had no `node_modules` for the AgentV/@agentv/core eval runner, and the ambient NODE_OPTIONS env var (`--import tsx ...`) was malformed, which also breaks bare `node`/`npm`. Self-healed in-session by running `npm ci` with NODE_OPTIONS unset for the subprocess (no repository code change required); cycle c2 in this same loop reran the identical recipe successfully after the fix. Pre-crash scoreboard metrics (parse_rate, latency) were still captured but ship gates never published, so this cycle is infrastructure-diagnosed, not a quality result.
